instructions: Rinse the strawberries, raspberries and blueberries. Hull the strawberries and slice them thin.
Peel the kiwis and slice them into thin rounds.
Spoon 3/4 cup of the cottage cheese into each of 4 bowls.
Top each bowl with the strawberries, kiwi, 1/4 cup of the raspberries and 2 tbsp of the blueberries.
Drizzle the honey over the bowls. Serve right away.
method_notes: Picky Eater's cottage cheese with fruit (5.0 from 7 ratings, below the 20 bar) is the lead; the fruit amounts are doubled for 4 bowls and the portion is 3/4 cup of cottage cheese per bowl. The Dizzy Cook agrees on cottage cheese, fruit and a little honey. Mint and chia seeds from the lead are left out to keep it plain for kids.
